title: Reducing Cognitive Overhead in Tool Use via Multi-Small-Agent Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2508.08882v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent advances in multi-agent systems highlight the potential of specialized small agents that collaborate via division of labor. Existing tool-integrated reasoning systems, however, often follow a single-agent paradigm in which one large model interleaves long-horizon reasoning with precise tool operations, leading to cognitive-load interference and unstable coordination. We present MSARL, a Multi-Small-Agent Reinforcement Learning framework that explicitly decouples reasoning from tool use. In MSARL, a Reasoning Agent decomposes problems and plans tool invocations, while multiple Tool Agents specialize in specific external tools, each trained via a combination of imitation learning and reinforcement learning with role-specific rewards. translated_title: 通过多小型智能体强化学习降低工具使用中的认知负担
translated_abstract: arXiv:2508.08882v5 公告类型：替换 摘要：多智能体系统的最新进展凸显了通过分工协作的专门化小型智能体的潜力。然而，现有的工具集成推理系统通常遵循单智能体范式，即由一个大模型在长程推理与精确工具操作之间交替执行，导致认知负载相互干扰、协调不稳定。我们提出了MSARL，一种多小型智能体强化学习框架，显式地将推理与工具使用解耦。在MSARL中，推理智能体负责分解问题并规划工具调用，而多个工具智能体则专门负责特定的外部工具，每个智能体通过模仿学习与带有角色特定奖励的强化学习相结合的方式进行训练。在结合代码执行的数学问题求解任务上，MSARL相比单智能体基线显著提升了推理稳定性和最终答案准确率。此外，该架构还可泛化至……
tldr: 提出MSARL多小型智能体强化学习框架，通过让推理智能体负责规划、多个专用工具智能体负责执行，将推理与工具使用显式解耦，显著提升了工具集成推理任务的稳定性与答案准确率。
en_tdlr: MSARL is a multi-small-agent reinforcement learning framework that decouples reasoning from tool use via a planning Reasoning Agent and specialized Tool Agents, significantly improving reasoning stability and answer accuracy in tool-integrated tasks.
